mentions.name: dub-anything
mentions.description: This tool generates subtitles and dubs for any video in the actors' own voices, making previously untranslated media watchable in English.
mentions.problem: A whole world of movies that have never been translated to English is previously inaccessible.
mentions.audience: I use it to watch movies that have never been translated to English.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Generate subtitles and dubs for any video, in the actors' own voices

https://github.com/swax/dub-anything
